0.long_answer: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis (GPA) is an autoimmune disease that was formerly known as Wegener's granulomatosis. It is characterized by inflammation of blood vessels (vasculitis) which can affect various organs, including the eyes. When the pigmented uveal layer of the eye becomes inflamed, this condition is referred to as uveitis. GPA is known to cause ocular manifestations, including uveitis, due to the inflammatory process affecting the vascular structures of the uvea.
